Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy for Language Flipper

 Last Updated: May 15, 2026

1. Introduction Welcome to Language Flipper (“we,” “our,” or “us”). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your information when you visit languageflipper.com (the “Website”) or use the Language Flipper desktop application (the “App”).

2. Information We Collect Information You Provide: When you contact us via our website form, we collect your name and email address. Payment Information: All purchases are processed securely through our third-party merchant of record, Gumroad. We do not directly collect or store your credit card details. Gumroad shares your name, email, and license key status with us to facilitate your access to the App. App License Verification: The Language Flipper desktop app operates locally on your machine. However, the App periodically connects to the internet to verify your active license key with our servers. This process securely transmits your license key and a localized identifier to confirm validity. We do not log or track your keystrokes, clipboard data, or the content of the text you flip.

3. Analytics and Tracking Technologies Our Website uses cookies and tracking technologies to improve user experience: Google Analytics 4: Used to understand website traffic and visitor behavior. Microsoft Clarity: Used for heatmaps and session recordings to help us identify UX issues and improve the Website. Clarity captures interactions on the Website, but sensitive input fields are masked. Cookie Consent: You can manage your tracking preferences at any time using the cookie consent banner provided on our Website.

4. How We Use Your Information We use the collected information to: Provide, maintain, and support the App and Website. Verify your Gumroad license key. Respond to your customer support requests. Analyze website performance and improve user experience.

5. Third-Party Services We utilize trusted third-party services for our operations, which are governed by their own respective privacy policies: Gumroad: For payment processing and license generation. GitHub Releases: For hosting and delivering our App installation files. Google & Microsoft: For website analytics.

6. Your Data Rights (GDPR & CCPA) Depending on your location, you have the right to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal data. You may also opt-out of non-essential cookies via our cookie banner. To exercise these rights, please contact us.

7. Contact Us If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at: Email: falafeltikunim@gmail.com

Or via the Contact page on our website.
